name: Air
notes: At 20 °C and 1 atm. Its density gives every object its drag and buoyancy.

name: Cardboard
notes: Corrugated board, its flutes counted in its density.

name: Concrete
notes: The disc is concrete.

name: Dander (Particle)
notes: A cloud of fine flakes of skin, fur or feathers: they flutter, drift and slowly settle on the floor.

name: Fabric (Cloth)
notes: Woven cotton, stuffed: the shape made in it is a cushion of fabric that squashes, sags and folds (a mesh of points held by threads, pushed out by its stuffing).

name: Fire (Particle)
notes: Hot glowing gas: a flame that stays where it is put.

name: Flubber (Jiggle)
notes: Fictional. Gives back nearly all the bounce it gets, off anything, and wobbles.

name: Foam (Soft)
notes: Squashes under what presses on it and springs back (a soft body).

name: Gelatin (Soft)
notes: Wobbles and dents where things press on it, then springs back (a soft body).

name: Glass
notes: Soda-lime.

name: Glow-in-the-Dark Plastic
notes: Plastic with a phosphor (strontium aluminate) mixed in.

name: Glue (Jiggle)
notes: PVA glue, set to a gel: sticks to whatever it touches, the floor too, until pulled apart.

name: Haze (Particle)
notes: Air carrying fine dust, smoke or droplets (an aerosol): it hangs where it is, drifting, and passes through things.

name: Heavy Fog (Particle)
notes: Cold air thick with droplets (as from dry ice): heavier than air, it sinks and spreads over the floor, passing through things.

name: Honey (Fluid)
notes: Very viscous. Simulated as droplets that flow, cling together and drag on each other.

name: Ice
notes: Slides on anything.

name: Iron (Cast)
notes: Metals' ior: the real part (they absorb, too).

name: Kryptonite
notes: Fictional. a glowing green crystal.

name: Lava
notes: Molten rock at ~1100 °C, crusting over: it glows through the cracks. A rigid blob until there's a fluid solver.

name: Leather
notes: Tanned hide.

name: Marble
notes: Calcite: decomposes ~825 °C.

name: Mercury (Fluid)
notes: Liquid metal; its vapour is toxic. Simulated as droplets that flow, cling together and drag on each other.

name: Mithril
notes: Fictional. lighter than aluminium, harder than steel, and rings like a bell.

name: Paper (Stack)
notes: Ignites ~230 °C.

name: Plasma (Glowing)
notes: Ionised gas: a glowing ball that hovers where it is put.

name: Porcelain
notes: Glazed, fired white clay: hard, glassy, rings when struck.

name: Rubber
notes: Squeaks when it slides.

name: Sand (Particle)
notes: Granular: angular grains that pour, interlock and heap, throwing up dust where struck.

name: Silicone (Soft)
notes: Rubbery: dents under pressure and springs back quickly (a soft body).

name: Smoke (Particle)
notes: Hot air (~120 °C) carrying soot: lighter than air, so it rises.

name: Snow (Packed)
notes: Crunches.

name: Steam (Particle)
notes: Water vapour at 100 °C: it rises.

name: Terracotta
notes: Unglazed fired earthenware: porous, matte, a dull clink when struck.

name: Unobtainium
notes: Fictional. a superconducting ore that hovers where it is left.

name: Vegetable Oil (Fluid)
notes: Smoke point ~230 °C. Simulated as droplets that flow, cling together and drag on each other.

name: Water (Fluid)
notes: Simulated as droplets that flow, cling together and drag on each other.

name: Wet Clay (Soft)
notes: Dents where things strike or press on it, and keeps the dents (a soft body that stays deformed).

name: Wood (Oak)
notes: Hardwood. Ignites ~300 °C.

name: Wood (Pine)
notes: Softwood. Ignites ~260 °C.

name: Wool (Soft)
notes: Loose fibre, mostly air: squashes under what presses on it, springs back slowly, and keeps some of a hard squeeze (a soft body).
